title: Dominic and the Compass
author: Emrys Amberdale
blurb: Petra Kavanagh, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
